name: The final pair in the mountain

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest-chain scene; in-world date unknown

summary: The last two tablets lie among the Smolderthorn trolls in Blackrock Spire. With this pair, the quest's six-tablet search reaches its stated count. The tablets deepen the written record, but the seeker still depends on Ironboot to interpret what they mean for the egg and for the power Yeh'kinya tried to contain.
